description:
OpenAI is expanding its Daybreak initiative to offer GPT-5.6-Cyber for authorised defensive security work. The programme gives approved defenders two access routes: Daybreak Blue for frontier general-purpose models, and Daybreak Red for purpose-trained cybersecurity models.
